title: extract_response description fallback "unknown" hides Option semantics
description: In client.rs, extract_response() uses err["description"].as_str().unwrap_or("unknown") to build an error message. The "unknown" fallback silently hides the case where no description was provided. This makes error messages like ClientError::MethodError("unknownMethod", "unknown") which is confusing. Better: use Option<&str> and format differently for Some vs None, e.g. "unknownMethod (no description)" or just "unknownMethod".
